title: Breaking-change exception ledger
description: Append-only record of intended breaking changes to the integration API. Only entries added in the current pull request can excuse its breaking changes; each such entry must match a change oasdiff reports, and the SDK version must be higher than on the base branch and equal to sdk_version.

change.description: The change as oasdiff prints it with --format singleline: METHOD /path followed by the change text. Matched case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace.

reason.description: Why the break is acceptable and how integrators are told.

exceptions.change: GET /integration/v1/organizations/{organization}/alerts/{uuid} changed the response property 'data/episode' type/format from 'string'/'' to 'integer'/''
exceptions.reason: The contract described episode as a string by mistake; the platform has always sent an integer and the SDK already validated it as one. Noted in the SDK 0.7.0 release notes.
